answer: Sable Interval Echo: each identity must emit its heartbeat traffic in a stable, low-variance phase band; a cipher mixes send times across the epoch, and the reef node holds a rolling histogram of inter-arrival gaps. Enforcers flag any identity whose timing entropy falls outside the band or whose phase drifts faster than the allowed rate. Spoofing many identities forces the attacker to maintain distinct, jitter-shaped schedules per account, costing continuous per-identity compute and timing discipline rather than one upfront fee.
